scripts.check: bun run typecheck && biome lint packages apps scripts tests
scripts.format: biome format --write packages apps scripts tests package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format packages apps scripts tests package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.lint: biome lint packages apps scripts tests
scripts.build:bun: bun build packages/core/src/index.ts apps/bun-runtime/src/index.ts apps/bun-runtime/src/migrate.ts apps/bun-runtime/src/sqlite-store.ts apps/bun-runtime/src/file-object-store.ts apps/bun-runtime/src/capabilities.ts apps/bun-runtime/src/bootstrap.ts apps/bun-runtime/src/rotate-secrets.ts --target=bun --outdir dist
scripts.build:dashboard: bun build apps/dashboard/src/main.ts --target=browser --outdir apps/dashboard/dist/assets && cp apps/dashboard/index.html apps/dashboard/dist/index.html
scripts.build: bun run build:bun && bun run build:cloudflare
